answer: In a decentralized AI network, the Byzantine Fault Tolerance (BFT) consensus algorithm can provide Sybil resistance through a voting bridge mechanism. Each agent maintains a unique relic of its identity, which is verified by other agents before participating in voting. When an agent attempts to fake its identity, its relic is detected, and it is excluded from the voting process. The majority of agents must agree on the outcome, effectively reaching the summit of consensus, ensuring the integrity of the network's decisions.
